identity.notes: Cooperative homeowners association (EASTERN SHORES COMMUNITY APTS INC.) at 3741 NE 170th St, North Miami Beach, FL 33160, established May 20, 1960. Managed by FPMS (5600 Granada Dr, Sarasota, FL 34231; phone 941-960-5000). Features a community pool and gated entry. The neighborhood also has city-funded improvements including sidewalks, upgraded street lighting, street overlays, a tot lot with shaded shelter, and intersection enhancements.

amenities.detail: Listed as a community amenity in the HOA association profile (florida-hoa.net). No further detail on size, hours, or access provided in the extracted content.
Explicitly listed as an amenity/feature of the association in the florida-hoa.net profile.

City of North Miami Beach installed a shelter and benches providing a shaded picnic area at the tot lot on NE 166th Street (PN Number 12). This is a public neighborhood feature, not confirmed as an HOA-managed amenity.
City installed 4-foot sidewalks throughout the portion east of 35th Ave (completed Apr 2002) and upgraded/added Cobra Head street lights (completed Dec 2003). Public infrastructure, not HOA-managed.
